summary: The municipality of Dordrecht says it unlawfully processed sensitive personal data for years while tackling public nuisance, according to Security.nl, which relays the municipality's own statement. Data of just over 1,000 people is involved, including health, criminal records and sexual orientation. The municipality has reported a data breach to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, which has started an investigation.
title: Dordrecht says it unlawfully processed sensitive data of just over 1,000 residents
